info.description: Sticky bar for a hub page: one chip per section that carries a Nav item, plus the filters of the filterable list on the page. It has no fields of its own — place it directly under the section it should stick below. Without a filterable list it shows the chips only.

showChips.description: Show one chip per section that carries a Nav item. Turn off for a bar that only offers the filters.

scrollToSections.description: A chip click scrolls to its section. Switch off to keep the chips as a read-only indicator of where you are.

filters.description: Which filters the bar offers, in order. Leave empty for Audience + Tag. Needs a filterable list (Layout: grid with filters) on the same page to have anything to filter.
